spec_match.rationale: Cumulative CLS from real entries; the 'reported in' readout is now a MEASUREMENT — comparing the entry source's currentRect against the shifted node's getBoundingClientRect (CSS px) — replacing the forbidden Chrome/14[5-9] UA sniff that would have broken at Chrome 150.

interactive.rationale: Zoom select, delayed inject and reset all work; trusted CDP click added 0.0037 to cumulative CLS and the unit probe reported 'CSS pixels (measured; note DPR=1 …)' — the readout populates where it previously discarded every click shift.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Lede matches; added note explains the 0.7s delay.

edge_cases.rationale: Probe reports honest inconclusive/DPR-1-coincidence states and counts input-attributed skips, but the three-zoom-level comparison relies on the non-standard CSS zoom property and the measured-unit distinction is only decisive on DPR>1 devices.

references.rationale: chromestatus link added to see-also (was missing — invariant 3).

runtime_evidence.rationale: Trusted CDP click at 1280: cumulative CLS 0.0037, skipped 0, unit 'CSS pixels (measured; DPR=1 caveat)'; mobile 360 scrollWidth 360; console clean except environmental fonts request; screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: zoom-checker-shift-recorded assert fires when a counted entry lands.

design_system.rationale: Variables only; stat innerHTML now uses textContent for values.

accessibility.rationale: Polite announce region for scheduled/recorded messages; countdown not announced; controls are native.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: 360x740 DPR3 scrollWidth 360; desktop verified; screenshots read.

openQuestions.title: Verify the unit measurement on a DPR>1 device and under real page zoom
openQuestions.detail: At DPR=1 CSS px and device px coincide, so the measured verdict carries an explicit caveat. A Chrome 145 run at DPR 2-3 (and with browser-level zoom rather than the CSS zoom property) should show the decisive branches, including the pre-145 device-pixel detection on older builds.

guidanceConsulted.query: status updates aria-live countdown delayed action
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Centralize announcements in a single polite live region; do not announce interstitial ticks or spam live regions.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Visible 0.1s countdown updates a plain status element; a separate visually-hidden aria-live=polite region receives only scheduled/fired/captured messages.

guidanceConsulted.query: feature detection never user agent sniffing
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Detect behaviour by observing the actual API result, never by parsing the UA string.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Replaced the Chrome/14[5-9] UA regex (which breaks at Chrome 150) with a rect-comparison measurement of the live layout-shift attribution source; unmeasurable states are labelled honestly instead of guessed.

summary: Fixed the dead readout (0.7s delayed injection with countdown), replaced the Chrome/14[5-9] UA sniff with a real measurement of the reporting unit (entry currentRect vs getBoundingClientRect, with honest DPR-1/inconclusive labelling), and added the missing chromestatus reference link. Browser-verified with headless Chromium 141.0.7390.37 via raw CDP (trusted Input.dispatchMouseEvent clicks, console/network capture, 360x740 DPR3 mobile + 1280x800 desktop emulation, screenshots read) — chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this cloud session. Chromium 141 predates Chrome 145, so 145-only success paths were validated on their honest fallback branches. The single failed fonts.googleapis.com stylesheet request is environmental and not counted against the page.
